how: We read the website of every Atlanta wedding florist listed on Lazo (193 listings, 161 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops and funeral florists that do not show wedding design work, a garland shop with a New Jersey address, venues and planners listed under florists, and a proposal-setup page. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
What holds up in Atlanta heat and humidity for an outdoor summer ceremony, and what will you refuse to put in direct sun?
Can I see a full wedding's florals, not a bouquet photo, at a budget like mine?

picks.name: The Cottage Florals & Event Designs
picks.blurb: Abby Saccamono founded The Cottage in 1999, and it has grown into a team of designers and event planners focused on weddings and events at North Georgia and metro Atlanta venues. Full-service, with each event built as a personalized floral experience.

picks.name: The Perfect Posey - Event Design & Wedding Florist
picks.blurb: Kelly Hillis does full-service wedding floral design out of Sharpsburg, and a client note on the site credits her with helping a couple stay within budget rather than running up the bill. The Perfect Posey is scheduling wedding dates through July 2027.

picks.name: Blosm | Stylish Stems
picks.blurb: Blosm is a Canton-based wedding florist and event design team with 10-plus years of custom florals, installations and draping, from understated elegance to extravagant luxury. Draping and curated decor come from the same team as the flowers.

picks.name: Flowers by Yona
picks.blurb: Flowers by Yona is an Atlanta florist and event designer doing bespoke floral and event design for weddings, corporate and social events, with years of experience behind lush, garden-inspired arrangements.

picks.name: September Tree Events & Rentals
picks.blurb: Something different: September Tree rents premium real-touch faux florals for weddings across North Georgia, bouquets, arches and flower walls that look like fresh and cost a fraction of the price. The owner brings fifteen years of story to it and a belief in celebrations free of stress and waste.

picks.name: Tulip
picks.blurb: Eva and Heather founded Tulip in 2005, now celebrating 20 years as one of the first women-owned floral design companies in the Southeast. Based in Atlanta with a presence on Florida's 30A coast.

picks.name: Flowers by Impressions
picks.blurb: Flowers by Impressions in Suwanee prints its wedding floral packages starting at $1,999 with no hidden fees, from elopements to full weddings across metro Atlanta. Consultations are offered to settle on style and theme.

picks.name: Milestones Floral Décor for Events
picks.blurb: Locally owned and operated for over 25 years, Milestones Floral in Smyrna does wedding and event flowers of all sizes and budgets and keeps a range of rental items alongside its galleries.

picks.name: Atlanta Flower Company
picks.blurb: Quiet, subtle, timeless flowers? Pass, says Atlanta Flower Co, which builds color-drenched statement installations meant to get the party started, plus interactive flower carts and event design. A fine art floral studio in East Point.

picks.name: The Rosier Co
picks.blurb: The Rosier Co is a luxury floral design studio in Smyrna crafting bouquets, ceremony arches, centerpieces and suspended installations, serving Atlanta, Duluth, Alpharetta, Roswell and all of Georgia. Curated wedding packages with pricing are laid out on the site.

picks.name: Southern Stems
picks.blurb: Leslie has been flowering professionally for 19 years and has designed for more than 500 weddings and events, a self-described hippie at heart who believes flowers can transform a space. Southern Stems serves Newnan, Peachtree City and the Atlanta area.

picks.name: Design House Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Design House is a full-service floral and event design company in Buford that has designed weddings for over 20 years at venues including Lanier Islands and Chateau Elan. Pricing varies with the design and is custom-built for each client.
